panels.title: JVB Health
panels.description: Red means the JVB health endpoint reports unhealthy or is unavailable.

panels.title: Firing Alerts
panels.description: Any non-zero value requires investigation in the alert table below.

panels.title: Host CPU
panels.description: Warning above 70%, critical above 85% sustained utilization.

panels.title: Host Memory
panels.description: Calculated from MemAvailable, not merely free memory.

panels.title: JVB Heap
panels.description: High sustained heap usage often precedes longer GC pauses.

panels.title: Root Disk Free
panels.description: Warning below 25%, critical below 15% free space.

panels.title: Active Bottleneck Alerts
panels.description: Prometheus rules identify sustained availability, quality, capacity, disk, JVM, and network problems.

panels.title: ICE Outcomes
panels.description: Any failed ICE increase indicates connectivity or NAT/firewall trouble.

panels.title: Conference Failure Counters
panels.description: Shows increments, not lifetime totals, so new failures stand out.

panels.title: RTP Transit Delay Quantiles
panels.description: Packet transit delay distribution reported by JVB; p95 growth indicates media-path pressure.

panels.title: Host Network Throughput
panels.description: Non-loopback and non-container interfaces. Sudden plateaus can reveal NIC or upstream limits.

panels.title: Network Drops and Errors
panels.description: Values above zero during calls indicate host NIC, driver, queue, or upstream pressure.

panels.title: Media Adaptation Signals
panels.description: Spikes in bitrate expirations or keyframe requests can accompany congestion and layer switching.

panels.title: UDP Stack Errors
panels.description: Receive-buffer errors are a strong signal that kernel socket buffers or CPU capacity are insufficient.

panels.title: JVM Garbage Collection
panels.description: Sustained GC time or increasing average pause indicates heap pressure or allocation churn.

panels.title: Load per CPU Core
panels.description: Values above 1 mean more runnable work than available CPU capacity.

panels.title: Disk Busy Time
panels.description: Near 100% sustained busy time indicates storage saturation.

panels.title: Systemd Service Failures
panels.description: Tracks failed state for the Jitsi and monitoring units.
